g.text: 100% SERVERLESS REAL-TIME PHISHING EMAIL DETECTION PLATFORM
AWS Well-Architected Serverless Event-Driven Machine Learning Architecture
• Model Preload: Global Scope initialization eliminates disk deserialization lag.
• MicroVM Runtime: Amazon Linux 2023 Firecracker container environment.
• Benchmark Metrics: Warm Latency = 13.8 ms | Memory Consumed = 142 MB / 512 MB.
• Cost Optimization: $0.00 / month (Fully covered by 3.2M free monthly seconds).
Zero-Cost Serverless Machine Learning Architecture (< 15 ms Latency)
• Governance: Private Registry | Vulnerability Scan on Push | KMS SSE-S3 Encryption.
• Lifecycle: Automated multi-stage Docker build packaging Scikit-learn, XGBoost & SciPy.
Unified Logging, Metric Alarms & Operational Dashboard
• Centralized Log Group: /aws/lambda/phishing-detection-fn (Captures full JSON payload, request IDs, memory & cold start reports)
• Real-Time Telemetry: Tracks Duration, Invocations, Errors, ConcurrentExecutions & Memory Utilization across microVM instances.
Least-Privilege Policies: AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole (CloudWatch Write) + Inline DynamoDB Policy (dynamodb:PutItem on PhishingDetectionLogs) + Inline SNS Policy (sns:Publish on PhishingAlertTopic)
